reason: The 6.2c and 8.1c figures are correct, but they cover the most liquid options on 39 stocks, not equity options generally. So 'paid about three quarters' contradicts the paper's main conclusion.
found: Averaging over all trades, the effective spread measure that takes account of high-frequency trade timing ability is just 67% of the average conventionally measured effective spread and 53% of the average quoted spread.

suggested_fix: For heavily traded options on 39 stocks in April 2003 to October 2006, conventionally measured effective spreads averaged 6.2 cents against quoted spreads of 8.1 cents; adjusting for trade timing, the authors estimate the average trade's cost at about half the quoted spread.
